decision_point_for_operator.what_is_needed: a DDL-capable production credential reachable from CI, to run the SAME green COW chain against production
options: A (0007 precedent): operator provides the production neondb_owner URL session-side (volatile env, 0600, never printed) — this lane applies the chain directly with the same drivers
B (CI-lever): operator adds the production owner URL as a GitHub secret (e.g. T011_PROD_OWNER_DATABASE_URL) — the workflow's prod-apply job is re-pointed at it and re-dispatched

C (rotation lever, needs explicit authorization): CI resets the production branch's neondb_owner password via the Neon API and applies — disclosure: any consumer holding the old owner URL (e.g. a future frozen-core boot) must be re-provisioned; NOT executed unilaterally
decision_point_for_operator.recommendation: B — one operator paste into GitHub secrets, then re-dispatch; keeps the credential out of session logs and the apply inside the audited CI receipt path
